evidence.purpose: Count deals in 2022 including and excluding cancelled deals
evidence.sql:
SELECT 
  count(*) AS deals_total, 
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS deals_not_cancelled,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS deals_cancelled
FROM v_deals 
WHERE deal_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' AND deal_date < DATE '2023-01-01'

cases.question: 2022-yil 3-yanvardagi «Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н» bitimlarida hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan bir tonna narxi so‘mda qancha? Barcha holatlarni kiriting.

result.question: 2022-yil 3-yanvardagi «Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н» bitimlarida hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan bir tonna narxi so‘mda qancha? Barcha holatlarni kiriting.
result.text:
2022-yil 3-yanvardagi «Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н» bo‘yicha bitimlarda (valyuta — o‘zbek so‘mi, o‘lchov birligi — tonna) bir tonna narxi:

- **Barcha holatlarni hisobga olganda** (14 ta bitim, jami 1 837 tonna, umumiy summa 1 386 021 150 so‘m): hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan narx — **754 502,53 so‘m/tonna**, oddiy o‘rtacha narx — **749 182,93 so‘m/tonna**.
- **«Аннулирован(Не оплачен)» holatidagi bitimlardan tashqari** (11 ta bitim, 1 744 tonna, 1 316 923 389 so‘m): hajm bo‘yicha o‘rtacha tortilgan narx — **755 116,62 so‘m/tonna**, oddiy o‘rtacha narx — **750 466,55 so‘m/tonna**.

evidence.purpose: Compute average prices for Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н on 2022-01-03
evidence.sql:
SELECT
  currency,
  unit,
  count(*) AS n_all,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS n_valid,
  round(sum(volume), 2) AS vol_all,
  round(sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS vol_valid,
  round(sum(amount), 2) AS amt_all,
  round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS amt_valid,
  round(sum(amount) / nullif(sum(volume), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_all,
  round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') / nullif(sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_valid,
  round(avg(unit_price), 2) AS simple_avg_all,
  round(avg(unit_price) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS simple_avg_valid
FROM v_deals
WHERE product = 'Портландцемент ЦЕМ I 42,5 Н'
  AND deal_date = DATE '2022-01-03'
GROUP BY currency, unit;

result.text:
3 января 2022 года по товару «Карбамид Марка Б» было заключено 2 сделки (обе не аннулированы) общим объёмом 144 тонны на сумму 498 376 276 сумов (Узбекский сум):

evidence.purpose: Calculate weighted and simple average price for Карбамид Марка Б on 2022-01-03
evidence.sql:
SELECT 
  product,
  currency,
  unit,
  count(*) AS n_all,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') AS n_not_cancelled,
  round(sum(amount) / nullif(sum(volume), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_all,
  round(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)') / nullif(sum(volume) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 0), 2) AS weighted_avg_not_cancelled,
  round(avg(unit_price), 2) AS simple_avg_all,
  round(avg(unit_price) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'Аннулирован(Не оплачен)'), 2) AS simple_avg_not_cancelled,

  round(sum(volume), 2) AS sum_volume_all

WHERE product IN ('Карбамид Марка Б', 'КАРБАМИД МАРКА Б', 'Мочевина (карбамид) Марка Б')
  AND deal_date = DATE '2022-01-03'
